# Signed history rewrite map

On 2026-08-30, the 293 unpublished `main` commits after signed remote base
`815bde454b15eda1c6e1e57e3d33d1a3048f0474` were joined by one compatibility
commit that repinned live Deepwyrm references to their signed same-tree
replacements. The resulting 294-commit graph was rewritten solely to add GPG
commit signatures.

For every mapped commit, the tree, commit message, author identity/date,
committer identity/date, and parent topology were preserved; parent object IDs
changed only where an unpublished parent was likewise signed. The existing
merge topology was retained. Every replacement signature verifies against
fingerprint `3068C88C61756A2D772F8C3D84A0F71707AE3AB8`.

The original requested tip `6aa6cc38595dad805af07d89e78393943b835490`
remains recoverable through
`refs/backup/wyrmroot-pre-sign-main-20260830-6aa6cc3`; its signed same-tree
replacement is `eaaef7de286890eef0f830e1fb0c55346add0b27`. The pre-rewrite
tip including the Deepwyrm repin,
`f77fdfe9b3647117748b3ceb7a6d3396e6536cb0`, remains recoverable through
`refs/backup/wyrmroot-pre-sign-with-deep-repin-20260830-f77fdfe`; its signed
same-tree replacement is `2c42b3ce3bef7c818c9bc9df8ef088179b129843`.

Historical validation and evidence files intentionally retain a pre-sign
identity when that identity is part of the request, receipt, artifact path, or
provenance bytes originally accepted. Use this map to resolve those identities
to the canonical signed history; do not rewrite immutable evidence. Live
Deepwyrm dependency and selector-build pins use the signed same-tree
replacements recorded by Deepwyrm's corresponding 2026-08-30 map.
